Bug_Details:
A class can be annotated with at most one scope annotation. Annotating a class with more than one scope annotation is invalid according to
the JSR-330 specification.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by annotating the class with two scope annotations, which is invalid according to the JSR-330 specification.
